neighbours.label: the slot just before 'every'/'everything' in a ratio or all-inclusive frame ('one nurse for [every]', 'a time and place for [everything]', 'we will do [everything]'), as against sentences on the same topics with no such quantifier frame
fire: In rural clinics there is one nurse for every 900 residents.
The school hired one teacher for every twenty pupils.
Back then, there was one car for every ten households.
With help from abroad, we will do everything we can to bring them home.
At the camp the ratio was one woman for every forty men.
My grandmother believed there was a season for everything.
The city plants one tree for every baby born there.
Together with the utility, we will do everything possible to restore power.
quiet: In rural clinics there is one nurse who drives between villages.
The school hired a new teacher last spring.
Back then, there was one car on our whole street.
With help from abroad, we finished the report by Friday.
At the camp there was a small kitchen and a single well.
My grandmother believed that winter was the best season.
The city plants trees along the river each spring.
Together with the utility, officials said the cut was caused by a storm.

predictions: fire 0.25-0.5 on 'for' in 'one X for every Y' and 'do' in 'will do everything'; same topics without the frame below 0.1
